caption: The drawing depicts a single silver or metallic pitcher or creamer with a tall, elegant, and slightly bulbous body set on a rounded base with beaded detailing along the base and the rim. The handle is thin, curved, and attached at the upper third of the vessel, arching gracefully above the top edge. The pitcher has a wide, flared spout with a beaded edge matching the base. On the main body of the pitcher, there is a script monogram with ornate letters. The drawing, done in grayscale pencil or graphite, is centered on a lightly yellowed rectangular sheet, with two additional bordered sketches: one in the upper left showing a decorative monogram encircled by a ribbon and leaves, and one in the lower right showing a minimal outline of the pitcher’s shape. The artist's signature appears in the lower right quadrant of the main image. The entire composition is framed within a lightly drawn square, and the background is plain with some visible aging at the edges.
title: Silver Pitcher
